name: Katie Gregory
source:
Aww, isn't Katie cute? Well, don't let that innocent exterior trick you into thinking she is all sweetness and light.

Katie is stuck sharing a room with her sister [url=/c127542]Erica Gregory[/url], sharing a classroom with a bunch of vapid friends, and has a perverted brain stuck inside that adorable little body.

She aches to escape it all. With her eyes on her sister Erica's dirty games, Katie will use her friends and family to lead her to freedom.

[From [url=https://www.dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Katie]DumbKoala[/url]]
